description: This file defines a utility class 'CoreConfiguration' that manages application properties using Java Properties, with methods to get and set properties, including default values, and integrates with Spring as a component.

classes.name: CoreConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring component class that encapsulates application configuration properties, providing methods to retrieve and set properties.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the current Properties object holding configuration properties.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets the Properties object with provided properties.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property given its key.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property given its key, with a default value if the property is not found or an error occurs.
